Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. For instance, feedback can be in the form of 'Since language models have the X failure mode...', 'Adding X can fix this error because...', 'Removing X can improve the objective function because...', 'Changing X to Y would fix the mistake ...', that gets at the downstream objective.

# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: In the edited image, is a mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
node.criteria: Inspect the edited image and compare the visible mug or mugs with the headphones. Pass only if a mug is clearly positioned to the right of the headphones. Fail if the image reliably shows no mug to their right. Use unknown if the objects or their relative positions cannot be determined reliably. This condition checks the requested final spatial relation only; a pass does not establish that the source mug itself was moved.
node.binding: The mug or mugs and the headphones in the edited image; assess their visible left-to-right positions.

node_traces.evidence: In the edited image, a clearly visible mug is positioned to the right of the headphones. There is also another mug to their left; the right-side mug satisfies the stated condition.
